name: custom-visibility
title: Custom visibility animation
summary: A promo banner whose entrance and exit are drawn by two defineVisibilityAnimation functions: riseIn fades it in while it rises 60 % of its height, shrinkOut fades it while it scales down to 80 % about its centre; animationSpec names them as enterFunction and exitFunction.
prompt: A 'Show offer' button that reveals a promo banner which rises and fades into place; tapping the banner dismisses it by shrinking and fading it away.
teaches: Define a transition once with defineVisibilityAnimation {name, params [progress, w, h, x, y], commands}; it runs every frame of the transition with progress 0→1
Draw the component yourself inside it: set paint alpha, translate or scale about (@x + @w / 2, @y + @h / 2), then drawComponentContent
Attach the functions with animationSpec enterFunction / exitFunction (enterAnimation and exitAnimation default to CUSTOM) and set the easing with visibilityEasing
pitfalls: defineVisibilityAnimation goes at the root, before the components that use it (a first-pass definition, like variable)
Exit progress also runs 0→1: write the exit as 1 - progress for alpha, not progress
drawComponentContent composites the component in a layer with the current paint alpha, so a paint alpha fades the whole subtree at once

snippets.note: riseIn: alpha = progress, translate dy = (1 - progress) * h * 0.6, drawComponentContent
shrinkOut: alpha 1 - progress, scale 1 - 0.2·progress about the centre
animationSpec {visibilityDuration: 500, visibilityEasing: DECELERATE, enterFunction: riseIn, exitFunction: shrinkOut}

check.describe: A tap on Show offer at 0.1 s, captured 0.2 s later. The banner is partly faded and still below its final place, rising into it; fully in place and opaque by 0.6 s. Resized (narrow 240, wide 540) the banner fills the width and wraps its lines on the narrow host; the rise distance is 60 % of the banner's own height (@h), so it scales with it.
